//TheTvDb: StillRecheck*: an aired episode without a still is rechecked on a schedule, except in a series that rarely has stills: fewer than StillRecheckMinStillPercent percent of its aired regular episodes have one, counted once at least StillRecheckMinAiredEpisodes have aired. 0 percent turns the exception off.
//Omdb: ApiKey belongs in user-secrets (dev: dotnet user-secrets set "Omdb:ApiKey" "<key>") or env vars (prod: Omdb__ApiKey), never here.
//Login: AllowedEmails is the registration allowlist; set it per env (empty = open, once bot defenses below are in place). Prod values come from .env.prod (Login__AllowedEmails__0, __1, ...). MaxRequestsPerEmailPerDay/MaxSignInEmailsPerHourSiteWide are in-memory abuse caps that matter most once the allowlist is empty.
//Digest: The weekly email digest (opt-in per user). Off by default: before setting Enabled to true, set Site:BaseUrl and fit MaxPerRun (users per hourly run) to the mail provider's limits; see the README checklist. Startup fails if it is enabled without Site:BaseUrl.
//Site: BaseUrl is the public address (e.g. https://recall.nu) used for links in emails sent by background jobs. No default; set per environment (Site__BaseUrl).
//Library: A series in the 'continue watching' queue with no watch activity for DormantAfterDays (for a series never started: since it was added) moves to the 'Haven't watched in a while' group; 0 turns that off. A regular season's first episode airing within PremiereReturnDays brings a dormant series back to the main list.
//Retention: How many days PruneOldDataTimer (daily) keeps rows that have served their purpose: login tokens after they expired or were consumed, emails after they were sent or gave up, notifications after they were read, the notified-episode ledger, and completed IMDb imports. 0 or less disables that category. Keep NotifiedEpisodeDays well above the notification job's 3-day look-back.
//Turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA on the sign-in form. Leave both empty to disable it (the form still works, just without this layer). Get free keys at https://dash.cloudflare.com (Turnstile) - SiteKey is public, SecretKey comes from .env.prod (Turnstile__SecretKey) and must never be committed.
//TrustedProxies: Whose X-Forwarded-For/Proto/Host headers are believed. Both lists empty = loopback + private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7), which fits a reverse proxy on the same host or Docker network. Set either list to trust exactly those instead: Addresses are single IPs, Networks are CIDR. Prod values go in .env.prod (TrustedProxies__Networks__0, __1, ...). Raise ForwardLimit only for a proxy chain (CDN -> proxy -> app), and then every hop but the first must be listed.
